meta.name: fullenrich-network-activation
meta.description: Use when the user says "activate co-founder network with FullEnrich", "enrich LinkedIn connections export", "qualify my LinkedIn connections CSV", "turn Connections.csv into a lead list", "FullEnrich network activation", or any variant indicating they want to convert a LinkedIn personal-network CSV export into ICP-qualified leads with FullEnrich-verified emails and phones. Reads the LinkedIn Data Export Connections.csv, applies an ICP filter, then enriches missing contact info via FullEnrich v2 with webhook callback delivery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将LinkedIn人脉导出转为合格线索
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有LinkedIn人脉CSV，想自动筛选并补全联系方式
copy.tagline_en: Turn LinkedIn connections export into qualified leads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a LinkedIn connections CSV and want to auto-filter and enrich contact info

howto.what: 读取 LinkedIn 导出的 Connections.csv 文件，根据 ICP 规则筛选联系人，评分后通过 FullEnrich 添加验证过的邮箱和电话，输出两个 CSV：合格列表和不合格列表。
howto.when: 当用户说“activate co-founder network with FullEnrich”、“enrich LinkedIn connections export”或“qualify my LinkedIn connections CSV”等时触发。

say.text: 把我的 Connections.csv 变成合格潜在客户列表。
say.note: Claude 会先显示信用余额和预估成本，需要你确认。

say.text: 用 FullEnrich 富化我的 LinkedIn 联系人。
say.note: Claude 会先以干运行模式预估成本。

howto.what_en: Reads a LinkedIn Connections.csv export, filters contacts by ICP criteria, scores them, then enriches missing emails and phones via FullEnrich, outputting two CSVs: a qualified list and a disqualified list.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says "activate co-founder network with FullEnrich", "enrich LinkedIn connections export", or "qualify my LinkedIn connections CSV", or similar.

say_en.text: Turn my Connections.csv into a qualified lead list.
Enrich my LinkedIn contacts with FullEnrich.
say_en.note: Claude will first run a dry-run to estimate cost.
